title: Wall Mount towel bar 24-Inch Solid Brass | Mambo Collection Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bath with a wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass, sized for 24-inch center-to-center mounting. Part of the mambo collection for a coordinated, designer look.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction for enduring performance
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished appearance
- Wall-mounted installation saves floor space and keeps towels within reach
- Designed to coordinate with matching mambo pieces for a cohesive bath
- Includes mounting plates and all installation hardware

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars; Shape: straight bar
- Center-to-center: 24 in; Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Overall size: 25 in W x 3 in H; Projection: 3 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb; Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: False
- Finishes: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement options such as Venetian Bronze, Antique Pewter, Lavender, Glokzin Teal, and Unlacquered Brass
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
